title: Longest Palindromic Substring Length
description: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring that reads the same from left to right and right to left. Matching is case-sensitive. Empty input returns zero.

solution.explanation: Expand outward from every character and every gap between characters. Each expansion measures one palindrome and stops at the first mismatch. The longest measured span is the answer.

tests.hint: A single character is a palindrome.
Either length-three center palindrome is acceptable.
The whole string can be the longest palindrome.
Without matching neighbors the longest span is one.
A repeated string forms a full palindrome.
A palindrome can stop before the last character.
Expand through a longer even-centered palindrome.
Repeated characters form a long palindrome.
The two separated five-character palindromes do not combine.
